这标志着我国算力基础设施建设正式迈入10万卡级部署阶段: This marks that China's computing power infrastructure construction has officially entered the stage of 100,000-card-level deployment.
曙光8000投用首周已实现满载运行，日均处理作业数突破15万个，单日处理作业峰值: In the first week of operation, Dawning 8000 achieved full-load operation, with daily average job processing exceeding 150,000, single-day job processing peak exceeding 500,000. It has completed multiple super-intelligence fusion application adaptations, covering multiple application scenarios including large model training, high-throughput inference, and scientific computing.
在近日举行的2026世界人工智能大会暨人工智能全球治理高级别会议上，曙光8000: At the recently held 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance, Dawning 8000 was listed as one of the ten "Museum Treasures" of this conference.
超算和智算都是处理海量数据、支撑前沿科技的算力基础设施: Both supercomputing and intelligent computing are computing power infrastructure that processes massive data and supports cutting-edge science and technology.
智算则偏重人工智能算法和模型创新，虽然对精度要求不高，但追求计算性能，支撑大模型: Intelligent computing focuses more on artificial intelligence algorithms and model innovation. While it does not have high precision requirements, it pursues computing performance and supports large model training and inference, natural language processing, autonomous driving, and other artificial intelligence fusion applications.
随着大模型规模提升、计算场景扩展和智能化应用的深入，亟须能够应对高并发、高吞吐、: As large model scales increase, computing scenarios expand, and intelligent applications deepen, there is an urgent need for a new generation of computing power infrastructure capable of handling high concurrency, high throughput, multiple precisions, and multi-task workloads.
“人工智能正在从大模型向智能体、具身智能快速演进，需要同时具备支持高精度的科学计: "Artificial intelligence is rapidly evolving from large models to intelligent agents and embodied intelligence, requiring the simultaneous capability to support high-precision scientific computing and low-precision artificial intelligence training. This requires further innovation in computing systems in terms of architecture, scale, energy efficiency, and reliability."
“面对庞大而异构的算力需求，构建开放、高效、协同的计算生态，成为释放智能计算价值: "Facing enormous and heterogeneous computing power demands, building an open, efficient, and collaborative computing ecosystem has become the key to releasing the value of intelligent computing."
作为超集群，曙光8000将成千上万张计算加速卡进行高速互联，在逻辑上将其整合为一: As a super cluster, Dawning 8000 interconnects thousands of computing acceleration cards at high speed, logically integrating them into a unified-dispatch "giant computer" to provide ultra-large-scale parallel computing power.
”中科曙光高级副总裁李斌解释，这意味着，一个芯片、一个计算单元既需要具备对科学工: "Li Bin, senior vice president of Sugon, explains that this means a chip and a computing unit need both the capability to support scientific and engineering computing and digital computing simulation, as well as the capability to support neural network algorithms."
李斌介绍：“曙光8000覆盖双精度64位到32位、16位、8位甚至更低精度，也提: Li Bin introduced: "Dawning 8000 covers double precision 64-bit down to 32-bit, 16-bit, 8-bit, and even lower precision, and also provides flexible mixed-precision invocation capabilities, satisfying computing demands for scientific computing, large model training, artificial intelligence inference, and industrial simulation."
在系统建设上，曙光8000具有“芯片、计算、存储、网络、散热、应用、服务”全链路: In terms of system construction, Dawning 8000 possesses full-chain, fully self-developed artificial intelligence infrastructure capabilities spanning "chips, computing, storage, networking, heat dissipation, applications, and services," achieving complete domestic production from the R&D of core components to system deployment.
”李斌举例，算力协同方面，随着体系结构向复杂的异构计算演进，任何计算或网络节点的: "Li Bin gave an example that in terms of computing power coordination, as system architecture evolves toward complex heterogeneous computing, any bottleneck in a computing or network node will cause significant overall performance degradation."
值得一提的是，国产算力芯片及基础软硬件生态的长足进步，为曙光8000系统建设提供: It is worth noting that the significant progress in domestic computing power chips and the ecosystem of fundamental software and hardware have provided important support for the construction of the Sunrise 8000 system.
这套存储系统能够支撑大模型训练和科学计算中的海量数据读写，保障大规模集群高效运行: This storage system can support massive data reads and writes in large model training and scientific computing, ensure efficient operation of large-scale clusters, and demonstrates that China's domestic high-end storage technology has achieved leading capabilities in the global computing power architecture.
支撑算力产业“攀高峰”“建高原”: Supporting the computing power industry to "scale new heights" and "build plateaus"
作为全国首个10万卡级超算、智算融合的算力资源池，曙光8000投用后即同步接入国: As China's first computing power resource pool integrating 100,000-card-level supercomputing and intelligent computing, the Sunrise 8000 system will be connected to the National Supercomputing Interconnect immediately upon launch, and through it access the nationwide integrated computing power network, providing computing power services to research institutions and industrial users, supporting scenarios such as weather forecasting, materials design, energy exploration, biomedicine, quantum computing, fluid simulation, industrial simulation, and large model training and inference, while fostering broader computing power coordination and application support.
“我国算力产业既要‘攀高峰’，也要‘建高原’: "China's computing power industry must both 'scale new heights' and 'build plateaus'"
2024年4月，由国家部委指导发起建设的国家超算互联网正式上线，已建成汇聚超35: In April 2024, the National Supercomputing Interconnect, initiated and guided by national departments, officially launched, and has built the country's largest integrated computing power network and application service platform, aggregating over 3.5 million CPU (central processor) cores and 250,000 GPU (computing acceleration) cards.
国家超算互联网郑州核心节点上线后，国家超算互联网面向新用户推出普惠资源包，包含2: Following the launch of the Zhengzhou core node of the National Supercomputing Interconnect, the network has introduced inclusive resource packages for new users, including 200 card-hours of computing power, 10 million token call quota, and 500GB of storage resources, with options to use mainstream large models.
人工智能开发者和中小企业则可以在正式投入前快速完成应用原型搭建和模型验证: Artificial intelligence developers and small and medium-sized enterprises can thus rapidly complete application prototype construction and model validation before formal deployment.
国家超算互联网总工程师郭庆介绍，除支撑重大科研攻关外，国家超算互联网正推动算力向: Guo Qing, chief engineer of the National Supercomputing Interconnect, noted that beyond supporting major scientific research breakthroughs, the National Supercomputing Interconnect is promoting the penetration of computing power to broader user groups. Currently, the network has accumulated over 1.4 million users, with the average user age continuously declining, allowing everyone from middle school students to professional researchers to access high-end computing power resources.
在典型场景中，该系统已支撑新一代气象大模型开发部署，推动能源领域核心成像算法在国: In typical scenarios, the system has already supported the development and deployment of a next-generation meteorological large model, promoted the migration and optimization of core imaging algorithms in the energy sector on domestic platforms, and supported ultra-large-scale tasks such as accelerating protein folding process simulations in the fields of biology, materials, and fluids.
“过去一年，我们基于国家超算互联网的底座，构建了若干科学计算智能体，将原来复杂的: "Over the past year, building on the foundation of the National Supercomputing Interconnect, we have developed a series of scientific computing intelligent agents, transforming previously complex scientific computing workflows into convenient intelligent agent services based on natural language interaction, now covering over 100 core computing scenarios."
